findings.body: The launcher embeds its source path using `{src!r}` (`tests/conftest.py:24,123`), so Windows backslashes are escaped in its Python source. Searching for `str(source.parent)` cannot match that escaped path. The replacement therefore leaves the launcher pointing at the original package, which cannot discover `new_ship.py`, and the assertion at line 81 fails. Windows runs this test in the suite (`.github/workflows/forge-next.yml:23–35`). Regenerate the launcher with `FORGE_SHIM.format(...)`, as `tests/test_split_commands.py:404` already does.
findings.title: Fix the fixture launcher rewrite on Windows
